## Data and licenses

Each state’s odds will be downloadable as a CSV, licensed under [CC BY-NC 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/): you may share and adapt them for noncommercial purposes, with credit to Scientific Draw Odds. Everything else on this site is © Conor McKinley, all rights reserved. For commercial use of anything here, email [contact@scientificdrawodds.com](mailto:contact@scientificdrawodds.com). Sources are the agencies’ own publications, cited in each state’s methodology. Predictions are frozen before each deadline and compared with the real draw afterward.

## Disclaimer

::: {.muted}
Scientific Draw Odds is not affiliated with any state wildlife agency. Odds are estimates built from public data and can be wrong. Permit counts, seasons and eligibility rules change; confirm them with the agency before you apply.
